column1: 21625§judicious§dʒuˈdɪʃəs§Archaeology makes clear that with judicious management selected parts of the region could support more people than anyone thought before.§考古学解释说，利用**明智**的管理方法，所选地区能够养活的人数能比以往任何人所能想象的都多。§
21626§landfill§ˈlændfɪl§Sand was driven into the seabed to strengthen it before the landfill was piled on top.§沙子被运到海床，在**垃圾**被堆在海床上之前对其进行加固。§
21627§cast§kɑːst§When we finally stop at the centre of an aisle, we pause and take stock, casting our eyes along the length of it.§我们最后到了过道的中间，停下来评估过道的状况，**目测**其长度。§
21628§uniform§ˈjuːnɪfɔːm§Traditionally uniforms were manufactured to protect the workers.§传统上，生产**制服**的目的是保护工人。§
21629§longitudinal§ˌlɒŋɡɪˈtjuːdənl§A longitudinal study of nurses working in two Canadian hospitals examined the reasons why nurses took absence from work.§在对两家加拿大医院的护士进行了**纵向**调查后，他们发现了护士旷工的原因。§
21630§disillusion§ˌdɪsɪˈluːʒn§A better educated and less accepting public has become disillusioned with the experts in general.§受教育水平更高而更为挑剔的公众一般来说对专家已**不再抱有幻想**。§
21631§clientele§ˌkliːənˈtel§If they see potential clientele going elsewhere, they might want to be able to offer a similar service.§如果他们看到一位潜在**客户**去了别处，他们应该希望能提供一种相似的服务。§
21632§holistic§həʊˈlɪstɪk§Usually, the holistic solutions are required for the environment problems.§通常来说，环境问题需要**整体性**的解决方案。§
21633§exodus§ˈeksədəs§There is a mass exodus of workers from the villages to the towns in this country.§该国有大批工人从乡村**涌向**城市。§改例句：主语 a mass exodus 是单数，are 改 is

21634§concur§kənˈkɜː(r)§He concurs that orthodox doctors could learn a lot about bedside manner and advising patients on preventative health from alternative therapists.§他**认同**这种观点：传统医生在对待病人的态度、举止上以及如何给予病人预防保健的建议上可以从替代疗法专家那里学到很多。§
21635§preventative§prɪˈventətɪv§It is possible that the police were able to take preventative action and avoid a possible riot.§警察能够采取一些**预防**措施以避免可能发生的暴动，这是可能的。§
21636§complementary§ˌkɒmplɪˈmentri§The survey suggested that complementary medicine is probably a better term than alternative medicine.§调查显示，比起替代医学，**辅助性**医学这一术语可能更加恰当。§

21637§adjunct§ˈædʒʌŋkt§Alternative medicine appears to be an adjunct, sought in times of disenchantment when conventional medicine seems not to offer the answer.§替代医学似乎变成了一种**附加物**。在传统医学因为无法提供答案而令人倍感失望的时候，人们发现了替代医学。§
21638§simplistic§sɪmˈplɪstɪk§But a closer inspection reveals this interpretation as too simplistic.§进一步的调查显示，这种解释过于**简单化**了。§
21639§hiccup§ˈhɪkʌp§We've had a few slight hiccups, but progress has generally been quite steady.§我们遇到过一些小**挫折**，但是总的来说还在稳步前进。§
21640§prowess§ˈpraʊəs§He found that the way the cats played had no significant effect on their hunting prowess in later life.§他发现，猫咪的玩耍方式对它日后的捕猎**技能**没有重大的影响。§
21641§engross§ɪnˈgrəʊs§As the number of students grew, it totally engrossed him.§随着学生人数的增多，他**全身心投入**了这项工作。§
21642§tease§tiːz§I used to get teased about my name until I changed it last year.§在去年我改了名字之前，别人总**笑话**我的名字。§
21643§exuberant§ɪgˈzjuːbərənt§After the spring rains, the hillside was covered with exuberant vegetation, attracting many birds and insects.§春雨过后，山坡上长满了**繁茂**的草木，吸引了许多鸟类和昆虫。§补例句
21644§cavort§kəˈvɔːt§Playful young animals use around two or three percent of their energy cavorting, and in children that figure can be close to fifteen percent.§动物幼崽会花费2%~3%的精力去**玩**，而小孩子会花去近15%。§

21645§socialise§ˈsəʊʃəlaɪz§One worry is that kids who spend a lot of time online at home are sometimes unable to socialise properly with other children when they are at school.§一个令人担忧的问题是，在家里花大量时间上网的孩子在上学的时候，有时无法与其他孩子进行适当的**社交**。§
21646§optimum§ˈɒptɪməm§The optimum time for playing would depend on when it was most advantageous for the young of a particular species to do so.§玩耍的**最佳**时间取决于何时玩耍对某一特定物种的幼崽最为有利。§
21647§creative§kriˈeɪtɪv§We give this system to save children the trouble of developing these creative skills.§我们提供这套系统，为孩子们省去了发展这些**创造性**技巧的麻烦。§
21648§molecule§ˈmɒlɪkjuːl§Watson demonstrated the structure of the DNA molecule.§沃森展示了DNA的**分子**结构。§

21649§fitness§ˈfɪtnəs§Specific behaviours which were seen to increase risk of disease, such as smoking, lack of fitness and unhealthy eating habits, were targeted.§一些被认为会加大疾病威胁的特定行为成为攻击的目标，如吸烟、缺少**锻炼**和不健康的饮食习惯。§
21650§regarding§rɪˈgɑːdɪŋ§You are allowed to ask questions regarding the fees you are paying.§你们可以**就**自己的付费问题进行提问。§
21651§contact§ˈkɒntækt§For further details, contact Mr. Smith, please.§欲知详情，请与史密斯先生**联系**。§
21652§consultant§kənˈsʌltənt§Marketing consultants have been gathering information about customers' shopping habits.§市场**顾问**一直在收集有关消费者购物习惯的资料。§
21653§secondary§ˈsekəndri§It took us three hours to decide the primary and secondary targets of this term.§我们花了三个小时才确定了这个学期的主要目标和**次要**目标。§
21654§fraction§ˈfrækʃn§The little boy has done only a fraction of his homework.§那小男孩只做了**一小部分**家庭作业。§

21655§dictation§dɪkˈteɪʃn§If you plan to take examinations, there are dictation and listening comprehension cassettes for you to practise with.§如果你打算参加考试，这里有**听写**和听力理解的录音带可供你练习。§改例句：comprehension 被断行连字符拆成 compre-hension
21656§engage§ɪnˈgeɪdʒ§Try to find humour in life and engage in activities that make you happy.§试着从生活中寻找乐趣，**参与**那些使你快乐的活动。§
21657§populate§ˈpɒpjuleɪt§The dinosaurs used to populate the earth.§恐龙曾经**生活**在地球上。§
21658§merchandising§ˈmɜːtʃəndaɪzɪŋ§Their activities of merchandising did not provide sufficient funds for them.§他们的**销售**活动并没有给他们带来足够的资金。§
21659§meteorology§ˌmiːtiəˈrɒlədʒi§The diagram shows how the Australian Bureau of Meteorology collects up-to-the-minute information on the weather.§该图表显示了澳大利亚**气象**局如何收集最新天气信息。§
21660§dealer§ˈdiːlə(r)§The collector bought antiques from a local dealer.§收藏家从一个当地**商人**那里买了些古董。§

21661§authorise§ˈɔːθəraɪz§When an authorised user wishes to enter or use the facility, the system scans the person's corresponding characteristics and attempts to match them against those on record.§被**授权**的用户如果想进入或使用这一工具，系统会对其相应的特征进行扫描并与记录里的资料进行核对。§
21662§spectator§spekˈteɪtə(r)§The spectators, as well as the participants, of the ancient Olympics were all male.§古代奥林匹克运动会的**观众**和运动员全都是男性。§
21663§compatriot§kəmˈpætriət§In France, Bob bumped into a compatriot from Denver.§鲍勃在法国偶遇了来自丹佛的**同胞**。§
21664§dreadful§ˈdredfl§He became an orphan after the dreadful disaster.§那场**可怕**的灾难后他就成了孤儿。§
21665§shuttle§ˈʃʌtl§The shuttle can carry devices for scientific inquiry.§这架**航天飞机**能携带科学考察装置。§
21666§entail§ɪnˈteɪl§The work entailed the processing of accounts and generating of invoices.§这份工作**需要**处理账目和开具发票。§

21667§contrary§ˈkɒntrəri§Contrary to what you might imagine, the size of the cycle is not determined by the size of the wheels, but by the size of the frame.§与你可能想象的**相反**，自行车的大小不是由车轮的尺寸决定的，而是由车架的大小决定的。§
21668§alert§əˈlɜːt§Troops in the Philippines have been put on full alert in anticipation of trouble during a planned general strike.§预期在计划的总罢工期间会有麻烦，菲律宾的军队已处于完全**戒备**状态。§
21669§shift§ʃɪft§Fishermen protested, and the port was shifted a further five kilometres to the south.§由于渔民的反对，港口又向南**移**了五公里。§
21670§mere§mɪə(r)§Mere denunciation will not solve this great problem.§**仅仅**靠谴责是解决不了这个大问题的。§
21671§monitor§ˈmɒnɪtə(r)§Some worry that governments and industry will be tempted to use the technology to monitor individual behaviour.§有人担心政府和企业会企图利用这项技术来**监控**个人行为。§
21672§derive§dɪˈraɪv§France derives three quarters of its electricity from nuclear power.§法国四分之三的电力**来自**核能。§
21673§desire§dɪˈzaɪə(r)§Many old folks desire to learn English in China.§在中国，很多老年人都**想**学英语。§
21674§minimal§ˈmɪnɪml§The new couple stayed with their parents, so their expenses were minimal.§这对新婚夫妇和父母住在一起，所以他们的花费**最少**。§
21675§sketch§sketʃ§He quickly sketched the view from the window.§他很快**勾勒**出了窗外的风景。§
21676§lag§læg§Western banks still lag behind financial institutions in most other regions of the country.§西部地区的银行仍然**落后**于这个国家其他大部分地区的金融机构。§
21677§trigger§ˈtrɪgə(r)§The earthquake triggered an avalanche.§地震**引发**了一场雪崩。§
21678§supplement§ˈsʌplɪment§A student loan is intended to supplement living costs of students.§学生贷款旨在**补贴**学生的生活费用。§
21679§offend§əˈfend§You should remind yourself not to offend against the customs when you are in the minority region.§当你在少数民族地区的时候，要提醒自己不要**冒犯**当地的风俗。§
21680§vivid§ˈvɪvɪd§The photos depicted vivid scenes of a suffragette's life.§这些照片**生动**地表现了一名妇女参政论者的生活。§
21681§enclose§ɪnˈkləʊz§The farmer enclosed his land and kept cattle away from his crops.§农民在田地四周**筑起围栏**，以使牛群远离庄稼。§
21682§dose§dəʊs§Nick injected the dog with a strong dose of morphine.§尼克给狗注射了**一剂**强效吗啡。§
21683§supply§səˈplaɪ§Underground water sources in Australia supply about 18% of the total water consumption.§澳大利亚用水**供给**的18%来自地下水。§
21684§compress§kəmˈpres§Puffs of compressed air shape the glass.§吹出的**压缩**空气使玻璃成型。§
21685§interest§ˈɪntrəst§Many young people are showing a lot of interest in higher education.§很多年轻人对高等教育很**感兴趣**。§改例句：a lot interest 缺 of，改 a lot of interest
21686§overcome§ˌəʊvəˈkʌm§I don't believe limited resources and ecological constraints are overcome by personal skills.§我相信个人技术不能**克服**资源有限和生态限制的困难。§
21687§achievement§əˈtʃiːvmənt§Winning the national science prize was a remarkable achievement for such a young research team.§对于这样一个年轻的研究团队来说，赢得国家科学奖是一项了不起的**成就**。§补例句
